decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - This purpose built end-of-terrace single-family dwellinghouse is considered to be of an insufficient size in accordance with the Council's residential conversion guidelines for sub-division, and the proposal would therefore result in the unacceptable loss of a small house suitable for single-family occupation, contrary to policy H.3.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).

Condition : 2 - The conversion of the single-family dwellinghouse into two self-contained two-bedroom flats would represent a cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would fail to meet the Council's standards for internal space provision and would fail to provide adequate private amenity space and off-street parking provision. The proposal would therefore result in             substandard living accommodation detrimental to the residential amenity of the future occupants of the proposed family sized accommodation, and would result in increased on-street parking pressure within the CPZ, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.3.4, H.4.1 and T.1.4.
description: Conversion of the existing roof space into a habitable room and change of use from a single family dwellinghouse into 1 x 2 bed ground floor flat and 1 x two bed flat at first floor and roof level with access to the ground floor flat to the rear of the property.
